required_check.expected_app_owner: must differ from shared repository owner ajoe734
required_check.source: Dedicated external GitHub App installation whose credential minting and runtime are unavailable to repository Actions and shared owner credentials

forbidden_issuers.reason: Every repository Actions workflow shares this identity, so candidate code can emit the same check name.
An App owned by the shared repository account does not establish an external credential boundary.

preconditions: Human/Ops gives explicit authorization for the named branch and exact captured baseline.

Human/Ops provisions a dedicated GitHub App owned outside ajoe734, grants only the minimum repository metadata/read plus checks:write permissions, and keeps private-key/installation-token minting outside repository Actions, the Pantheon repo, the status root, and shared owner runtime.

The external verifier independently fetches the PR, rejects every base except dev/master before loading verifier code, pins the exact captured base SHA, evaluates the signed reviewer envelope, and publishes the exact-head check through only the dedicated App installation token.
The external verifier re-evaluates pull-request and issue-comment changes plus expiry/key-revocation deadlines so a stale success cannot survive.
.github/canonical-review-keys.json has been populated by a separately reviewed bootstrap PR; the shipped empty registry intentionally fails closed.
Each reviewer signer key is absolute, mode 0600, outside the repository and status root, and exposed only to the protected governed command runtime.
A successful signed canary check has been fetched read-only from GitHub; its name, head SHA, check-run id, App id, App slug, and external App owner are retained as the --issuer-check-run-json input.
scripts/git/canonical_review_check.py protection-plan accepts that canary. It must reject app id 15368, slug github-actions, an App owned by ajoe734, a wrong-name check, or a non-successful canary.
A fresh full protection response, scoped required-review response, enforce-admin response, repository response, and ruleset response have been captured after any external freeze/release operation.
The freshly generated machine plan preserves strict plus every unrelated context/app_id pair and writes rollback payloads before activation.
.github/workflows/canonical-review-gate.yml remains a read-only diagnostic workflow and is never selected as the merge-authoritative required check.

activation_order.reason: Block UI and GraphQL auto-merge creation; approved gated tasks merge only through exact-head integrator.
Make branch requirements apply to the shared admin credential.

body_contract.checks: preserve every fresh baseline check and append exactly one {context: Pantheon canonical reviewer attestation, app_id: <verified dedicated external App id from canary>}

activation_order.reason: Only the separately provisioned external App can satisfy the canonical required-check identity.

must_prove: machine plan schema v2 binds the dedicated App id, slug, external owner, canary check-run id/head/digest, and explicit rejection of github-actions app id 15368
exact context occurs once with the dedicated external App id from the retained successful canary
a same-name success from github-actions app id 15368 does not satisfy readback
strict is identical to the fresh pre-activation baseline
the full pre-existing required-check context/app_id multiset is unchanged except replacement of any same-name canonical context by the dedicated App-pinned check
missing, rejected, stale-head, forged, expired, and self-owned attestations produce a failing exact-head check

rollback.trigger: Any missing/unreadable key registry, missing external issuer, wrong App identity, lost pre-existing check, canary false pass, merge bypass, or external verifier outage.
order: PATCH the branch required_status_checks endpoint with the exact fresh pre-activation strict/checks payload.
Restore enforce_admins with POST or DELETE exactly as recorded in the fresh baseline.
PATCH repository allow_auto_merge to the exact fresh baseline value.
Read back full protection, scoped required reviews, enforce_admins, repository settings, and rulesets; compare with the baseline digest.
